segments.name: Reservoir Description
segments.description: Characterizes reservoir rock and reservoir fluids for oil and gas clients, supporting production, recovery, carbon capture and energy transition projects.
segments.evidence: Encompasses the characterization of petroleum reservoir rock and reservoir fluids samples to increase production and improve recovery of crude oil and natural gas from our clients' reservoirs.

segments.name: Production Enhancement
segments.description: Provides well completion, perforation, stimulation and abandonment services and manufactured perforating products to oil and gas operators worldwide.
segments.evidence: Includes services and manufactured products associated with reservoir well completions, perforations, stimulation, production and well abandonment.

revenueModel.text: Oil and gas industry clients pay Core Lab for reservoir characterization services and for manufactured products that improve reservoir performance and increase recovery.
revenueModel.evidence: We derive our revenue from services and product sales to clients primarily in the oil and gas and associated industries.
